extracted.name: Halloween M&M Ghoul Cookies
extracted.description: Cookies I made with Halloween M&M. This dough recipe is also good for chocolate chip cookies. #GoldenApron23 week 11 vanilla #halloween
ingredient_lines: Half a bag M&M candies or chocolate chips
instruction_lines: Mix sugars and butters till nice and creamy. Then add eggs and extract
In a separate bowl, mix the dry ingredients, then add to the sugar/egg/butter mixture.
Once well combined, add M&M and fold gently till well mixed.
Refrigerate for at least an hour.
Place dough in a cookie sheet and bake 350 for about 12 minutes.
